label: <DEL> step and late-original y/0 inputs (low precision)
explanation: Never active during the copy phase (t > L) or at t < 2. About 55% of activation mass is on the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0), and about 28% is on original-phase inputs of y (also 0, at about 7% of mass), mostly the first occurrence and at t >= 3. Predicate <DEL> OR (original y at t>=2) covers 79% of active steps and 83% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 9%: the neuron fires on just 7% of <DEL> steps and about 6% of y inputs. At <DEL> the rate is higher when the first original token (the token about to be output) is a, p or k (29% precision for that subset), and for longer sequences. The largest activations are on y inputs late in the original sequence. What gates firing within these contexts was not found. Rare on most other tokens and does not fire on repeated tokens (in_first=0 holds only 5% of mass).
